mutants.name: skip-validation
mutants.replacement: import {validateEntries} from './entries.mjs';export function reconcile(entries){const currencies=new Map();for(const e of entries){let accounts=currencies.get(e.currency);if(!accounts)currencies.set(e.currency,accounts=new Map());accounts.set(e.account,(accounts.get(e.account)??0)+e.delta);}return [...currencies].sort(([a],[b])=>a<b?-1:a>b?1:0).map(([currency,map])=>{const accounts=[...map].sort(([a],[b])=>a<b?-1:a>b?1:0).map(([account,delta])=>({account,delta}));const total=accounts.reduce((n,a)=>n+a.delta,0);return {currency,accounts,total,balanced:total===0};});}

mutants.name: drop-zero-net-accounts
mutants.replacement: import {validateEntries} from './entries.mjs';export function reconcile(entries){validateEntries(entries);const currencies=new Map();for(const e of entries){let accounts=currencies.get(e.currency);if(!accounts)currencies.set(e.currency,accounts=new Map());accounts.set(e.account,(accounts.get(e.account)??0)+e.delta);}return [...currencies].sort(([a],[b])=>a<b?-1:a>b?1:0).map(([currency,map])=>{const accounts=[...map].sort(([a],[b])=>a<b?-1:a>b?1:0).map(([account,delta])=>({account,delta})).filter(a=>a.delta!==0);const total=accounts.reduce((n,a)=>n+a.delta,0);return {currency,accounts,total,balanced:total===0};});}
